concerns.location: tasks.md:Dependencies and requirement coverage ('No task writes to `state/`')
concerns.text: Plan §Versioning and Hashing and Constitution Principle V / Data Hygiene mandate that utils.py update state/projects/PROJ-055-...yaml artifact_hashes on every write to data/, results/, logs/. Tasks explicitly forbid any task writing to state/, and no task implements the state-update or hash-recording step, silently dropping a constitutional constraint. Either a task must implement it via utils.py (as the plan specifies) or the plan must be amended to document platform ownership.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T001 verification vs spec.md:US-1 Independent Test / SC-001
concerns.text: US-1's independent test sets a measurable acceptance criterion: output contains '>90% of unique species in the source datasets with valid identifiers'. T001's verification only says 'report matched/total species in the run log' — the >90% criterion is never evaluated anywhere, a dropped acceptance criterion. Add an explicit check (or a documented, spec-sanctioned relaxation) in T001's verification.

T003 requires results/model_summary.csv to 'exist, be non-empty, and validate against the schema' AND to skip the fit when n_species < 15. The schema requires fixed_effect_telomere, p_value_telomere, phylogenetic_lambda, aic_score, n_species (min 1) — a skipped fit cannot produce a schema-valid row, making T003's verification unsatisfiable on the low-power path. The task must specify what the low-power row contains (e.g., low_power_flag=true with null/placeholder handling sanctioned by the contract) or the verification must branch.

concerns.location: tasks.md (whole document) vs constitution.md:Reproducibility Requirements / plan.md:Constitution Check
concerns.text: The plan's Principle I PASS claim rests on pinned requirements.txt and renv.lock, and the constitution REQUIRES a pinned requirements.txt at code/. No task creates, verifies, or even mentions requirements.txt or renv.lock (T002 covers only config.yaml). A constitutional reproducibility requirement has no implementing task.

T005 invokes 'the existing code/R/03_fit_moderator.R', but the plan's project structure lists only code/R/01_fit_pglS.R and 02_sensitivity.R; the moderator script is untraceable to any plan component. Either add it to the plan's structure or have T005 create it.

Plan Phase 6 assigns sensitivity to 05_visualize.py (or 04_sensitivity.py); T004 implements it inside 04_model_pglS.py calling code/R/02_sensitivity.R. The component-ownership mismatch should be reconciled in the plan so the task list doesn't silently re-assign plan-mandated structure.
Tasks produce data/processed/merged_data.csv while the data model names processed/telomere_standardized.csv and processed/merged_analysis.csv. Filename drift vs a read-only contract; align one side.
